scientific_purpose: Determine whether source-trained LATFUSE018 continuous historical-content models distinguish the requested original past timestamp, rather than predict an episode pollution level from current context. Use unchanged real source/checkpoints, correct versus wrong legitimate historical clocks at the same state, and within-window content discrimination.
causal_protocol: Use original FIT-only pre-March2014 source normalization and causal last/age caches. Replay each original owner from anchor-23 through query=anchor+64. Both predictors receive only feature prefixes, never raw/targets/future feature rows. Query only original timestamps anchor+0,8,16,24,32,40,48,56. Scoring targets/masks are consulted after both model outputs. No oracle source WRITE keys.
checkpoint_policy: Pin original code, original PLAN/RESULTS and all four LATFUSE018 checkpoint hashes; verify checkpoint source/seed/order/steps and original state_dict before/after; no optimizer or weight changes; reproduce exact results in a fresh Python process.

cohort.selection: Exactly original station/96-hour grid rows and original missingness; no score-based selection or new cohort

primary.question: At original trained H64 lag, is the correct legal past-clock prediction more accurate than wrong past-clock predictions or their timestamp-average, at identical current state?
controls: mean absolute target error of seven other legal historical clocks (diagnostic mismatched query-target control)
absolute target error of mean of all eight legal clock predictions (target-free episode-constant readout)
primary.gate: For BOTH original associative model seeds: >=5% lower H64 normalized absolute error versus EACH control with strictly positive lower station-block-bootstrap95 mean error-gain interval. Also positive within-window centered skill and >=5% lower centered MSE than original trained fastslow control with positive lower station-block-bootstrap95 error-gain bound.

metrics: H64 original normalized/log1p PM2.5 MAE and prior/zero-read/current-last baselines
centered skill = 1 - mean_window(mean_observed(((p-p_mean_observed)-(y-y_mean_observed))**2)) / mean_window(mean_observed((y-y_mean_observed)**2)); target means used only for scoring
prediction versus true physical within-window range and centered error
original N=1 versus first N=8 query output equivalence
secondary.missingness: Predict all eight legal queries. Score only genuinely observed original PM2.5 targets. Preserve masks/counts. Centered metrics require >=2 observed values; undefined/zero target variance is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.

bootstrap.unit: physical source station, retaining all windows/query targets per selected station; regional dependence remains

limitations: Only H64 was trained. Within-window lags8..56 and wrong-clock queries are out-of-training-lag diagnostics, not independent generalization proof.
Repeatedly exposed FIT and only two checkpoints per arm; do not pool seeds as independent source windows.
Zero-matrix intervention is OOD. Demeaning uses factual targets only in scoring, never model inputs or a deployed predictor.
No architecture or parameter change, no retraining, no new calibration. Full PNDS whole-model IEEE/AD/Lean equivalence remains OPEN.
prior_art_reuse: LATFUSE014 PR478: same-window real timestamp controls; no novelty claimed for that method
LATFUSE018 PR484: existing source-real continuous content objective and frozen matched controls
